description: LPG monthly weight in kg, Jan - Dec 2025 (no 2026 rows). The source column is headed 'consumption_litre', but the project owner confirmed on 2026-09-30 that its values are kilograms. v1 normalized them as lpg_consumption_litres / L; v2 reinterprets the same source bytes as lpg_weight_kg / kg with no numeric conversion.
